title: Do not provide prohibited interactive gambling services to Australians
what: Prohibited interactive gambling services, such as online casino-style games, must not be provided to customers in Australia.

sources.title: Interactive Gambling Act 2001
sources.quote: 15 Prohibited interactive gambling services not to be provided to customers in Australia (1) A person commits an offence if: (a) the person intentionally provides a prohibited interactive gambling service; and (b) the service has an Australian-customer link (see section 8).

reach.condition: if it provides interactive gambling services

assessment.summary: Prohibited interactive gambling services may not be offered to Australian customers.

marks.reason: A ban on a whole category of online gambling services, which shelters providers of the permitted forms from that competition.
Permitted gambling providers face no competition from the banned online services.
